heading: I'm Robin, Lead Cloud & Software Architect from Darmstadt.
subheading: Since 2015, I have been developing cloud and fullstack solutions with a focus on clean architecture, stable operations, and sustainable further development.
about:
I am a Lead Cloud & Software Architect currently working at FlexHome.Energy on a platform for a more sustainable energy supply. I have been developing software professionally since 2015, today with a focus on designing, evolving, and stabilizing complex web and cloud platforms. My work combines technical leadership through architecture, standards, and long-term technical decisions with hands-on feature-level implementation as a strong individual contributor.

It is important to me to build software that has real company-wide impact and truly benefits users: frontend, backend, and cloud working seamlessly together, well implemented, user-friendly, scalable, and reliable. I enjoy working with teams that take both product outcomes and engineering quality seriously.

experience.description: Architecture and technical leadership of the FlexHome.Energy cloud and IoT platform, responsible for scalability, stability, and security. Building backend, data, and Kubernetes infrastructure, defining technical standards, mentoring developers, and acting as the go-to person for AI topics.

Design and development of the cloud architecture and services for the FlexHome.Energy platform, including smart energy management solutions with bidirectional battery storage, backend with MQTT APIs and time series databases, an analytics and management console, and a REST API wrapper for customer onboarding.

Expansion of the AWS backend with robust APIs and time-series databases for data from microinverters and smart gateways for solar systems. Development of a comprehensive Electron application for R&D, manufacturing, and cloud engineering, integrating REST APIs and directly interfacing with hardware components.

experience.position: Software Engineer in Management Information Systems
experience.description: Test-driven and agile full-stack development (TDD) of web applications. Development of Android apps and backends for ordering medication. Migration of critical services to a modern tech stack with API-first design and module federation.

experience.position: Working Student Developer in Management Information Systems
experience.description: Extension and new development of Android apps and container-based backends for ordering medication as well as the development of a test-driven full-stack application for nursing home ordering.
Development of a web-based analytics platform as well as analysis and automated data processing with Excel and VBA.
